title: Test Coverage Gap Map
purpose: Visualize test coverage across all module categories showing file counts, tested file counts, coverage percentages, and critical observations for untested areas.
audience: QA engineers, engineering leads, developers, project managers
description: Test coverage matrix showing critical gaps across all tiers. Untested/Near-Zero Coverage: Models (0/13 files, 0%), Middleware (0/4 files, 0%), Routes (0/15 files, 0%), Config (0/8+ files, 0%), Frontend Components (0/28+ files, 0%), Frontend Hooks (0/9 files, 0%), Frontend Lib (0/6 files, 0%), Smart Contract (0/1 file, 0%). Low Coverage: Controllers (1/15 files, ~7% — auth.controller.test.ts only), Services (1/15 files, ~7% — auth.service.test.ts only). Partial Coverage: Utils (4/13 files, ~31% — apiError, asyncHandler, etc.). E2E Tests: 5 Playwright specs written but 0% automated (not in CI). Overall only 6 of 127+ files have tests (~5%). The database layer (13 models), all frontend components (28+), middleware (4), routes (15), and the smart contract (1) have zero tests.
preconditions: Codebase has been analyzed for test files across all module categories
Test files exist in tests/ directories
postconditions: Coverage gaps are visualized for prioritization
